skill.beyondsolo.sovereign_hand.flavour: A hand nobody can see, as strong as your will.
skill.beyondsolo.sovereign_hand.desc: Seize a creature up to %s blocks away and hold it helpless before you for %s seconds. Press again to hurl it where you look for %s damage. Bosses are pinned down instead. At nothing, it shoves foes and turns arrows back.
skill.beyondsolo.umbral_exchange.flavour: Where your shadow stands, you can stand.
skill.beyondsolo.umbral_exchange.desc: Trade places with one of your shadows: the one you look at (up to %s blocks), or a guard at its post the way you look, however far away in this world. A guard keeps guarding.
skill.beyondsolo.umbral_exchange.none: No shadow of yours that way. Look at one, or toward a guard's post.
skill.beyondsolo.umbral_exchange.no_army: You have no shadows to trade places with.
shadows.beyondsolo.guarding: On guard %s blocks away. It fights anything near its post and rises there again when you return.
shadows.beyondsolo.guarding.elsewhere: On guard in another world. It rises at its post again when you go back there.
shadow.beyondsolo.post.body: %s stands guard here. It fights whatever comes near, and rises here again whenever you come back.
shadow.beyondsolo.post.not_here.body: Shadows can only be left on guard out in the world, not inside gates or the System's own places.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.shadow.post: Leaves every shadow that is out on guard where it stands, or takes every guard off its post.
Lists where the player's shadows stand guard.
command.beyondsolo.solo.shadow.post.away: %s at %s in %s, %s blocks away (rises when someone comes near)
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.no_guard_h: %s is somewhere shadows can't stand guard (inside a gate or the System's own places).
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.no_shadows: %s has no shadows out to leave on guard.
